name: clear-metal-tongs-from-panini-press-before-closing-platen
title: Lower the commercial panini press upper platen onto the grill plate
instruction: Lower the propped upper platen of the commercial panini press until seated flush on the lower grill plate, then retract both hands clear.
context: Fast food and counter workers (BLS SOC 35-3023: 3,460,000 workers) and food preparation workers (BLS SOC 35-2021: 891,000 workers), representing over 4.35 million US food service personnel, routinely operate commercial grooved panini presses and contact grills (Waring Commercial / Vollrath standard). Under commercial culinary safety standards, closing a 450°F, 7 kg spring-counterbalanced cast-iron platen while stainless steel utility tongs inadvertently obstruct the lower grill surface violently ejects boiling grease and aerosolized oil droplets onto the operator's face and arms, while bending platen hinge linkages and causing electrical heating element arcing and fire. A competent food prep worker must recognize the foreign metal hazard, safely clear the tongs to the adjacent side prep rest tray, and grasp only the insulated front handle (avoiding heated grill surfaces) to smoothly lower the counterbalanced platen to the closed cooking position.
setup: Commercial prep counter (Z=0.7475 m). Center: tabletop commercial grooved panini grill (280x300x190 mm, 7.5 kg cast iron/chassis) at (0.280, 0.040) m with lower grooved plate at Z=0.8075 m, insulated front handle at (0.250, 0.040, 0.950) m, and upper platen propped open at 75 degrees. Stainless utility tongs (220 mm length, 180 g) lie across the lower grill surface. Right side: stainless prep staging rest tray at (0.280, 0.250, 0.760) m.
scoring: Stage progression: 0.20: metal tongs grasped and lifted clear of lower grill plate (>45 mm); 0.50: tongs deposited safely onto side rest tray (>80 mm from grill perimeter); 0.75: left gripper grasps insulated platen handle and pivots platen down past 45 degrees; 0.90: upper platen fully seated flush against lower mechanical stop (<15 mm vertical gap); 1.00: upper platen flush, both hands retracted clear (TCPs >= 45 mm, collision hulls clear), and assembly resting still for >= 20 steps (1.0 s). Defect latches (0.0): lowering platen while tongs remain on lower grill (grease expulsion / fire hazard), gripper fingers contacting heated grill plates (burn hazard), dropped tongs, or hands not clear.
reset_notes: Lift upper platen to 75 degree detent, return stainless tongs across lower grooved grill plate, and clear side staging tray.
fidelity: Rigid bodies and composite collision boxes for rectangular panini press chassis, lower grooved grill plate, counterbalanced upper platen with insulated front handle, stainless utility tongs, and side rest tray. Physical revolute joint on upper platen with torsional counterweight resistance and mechanical stops. Non-latched live state scoring with safety defect interlock.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0; scripted demo: 1.0 (two complete runs, 350 steps each).
